messages:
maria: quick design pass on the onboarding popover flow — pushed a tiny update to Figma (link in thread). main aims: make it feel lighter and ensure keyboard/stacking accessibility. alex: saw the screens, thanks. main thing for eng is the popover stacking on small viewports — currently it overflows the footer. can we clamp height and turn body into scrollable region? maria: yep, that's the plan. clamp at 60vh for mobile, 40vh for narrow sidebars. i'll add a note in the spec. jon: copy comment — primary CTA currently reads "Get Started" which is a bit vague inside the quickstart context. sugest: "Create sample project" or "Try sample app" to reduce cognitive load. cassie: +1 for more specific CTAs. also we should avoid sentence fragments that rely on visual context (e.g., "Connect a model"). make explicit: "Connect a model to your project". maria: good calls. i'll replace CTAs: primary = "Create sample project", secondary = "Skip and continue". will also extend body copy to include one-line explainer under headings. sasha: accessibility nits: 1) ensure the popover has role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" so screen readers know modal context; 2) add aria-label or aria-labelledby; 3) trap focus and return focus to the triggering button on close. alex: for implementation, we can use the existing Popover component but it needs a prop to enable focus-trap + aria attributes. i'll add a small PR template. maria: adding a tiny code snippet to spec for clarity: ```

Create your first project

``` cassie: Also color/contrast check — the subtle gray hint text is currently 3:1 on dark mode. bump to meet 4.5:1 for body copy or 3:1 for helper text only. will paste exact tokens. maria: thanks — i'll update the token list. also proposing a small "skip" link in the bottom-left so keyboard users can bypass quickly (visible focus state required). jon: tiny UX question — after "Create sample project", do we run the quickstart in an iframe or redirect to the project page with onboarding tour? i think redirect + ephemeral toast is better for performance. alex: redirect sounds safer for resource isolation. the iframe caused issues in staging previously (auth cookie scoping). maria: noted. design decision: redirect to project page + open ephemeral guided tour (dismissible) — added to spec. deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/popovers v2 -> 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC (after alex's PR lands). sasha: test plan notes: keyboard nav test, screenreader walkthrough, contrast lint, mobile viewport overflow. can we add a paired dev+design QA session next week? maria: yes — propose Wed 10am PT. i'll send calendar invite and include the Figma link + checklist. cassie: tiny copy tweak for toast after redirect: change "Project created" -> "Sample project ready — open quickstart" to surface next action. maria: done. i'll update all copy strings in the content spreadsheet and ping i18n for translations. alex: assigning implementation ticket to me: ENG-4527. i'll post PR link when ready and ping this thread for final sign-off. :thumbsup: maria: awesome — thanks everyone. short follow-up: can people add any final microcopy suggestions by EOD so i can lock strings before i18n handoff? jon: will do. cassie: done in doc. :sparkles:
